subject: Update gitignore to ignore the cluster-cluster test files (#756)
reason: The change modifies only .gitignore, widening three ignore patterns (dump.rdb -> dump*.rdb, appendonlydir -> appendonlydir*, nodes.conf -> nodes*.conf) so cluster-cluster test artifacts are untracked. It is a repository housekeeping/CI-hygiene change with no code, config, protocol, or behaviour change in Valkey, so no scenario can reach it and none is needed.
